item.summary: According to Børsen, customer interest in crypto investment products at Danske Bank and Nordea has been extremely limited, even though the banks have spoken of strong interest. A Danmarks Nationalbank staff paper dated 15 April 2026, not a new November survey, found that household exposure to crypto assets in Denmark remains low, and noted that the two banks now offer crypto exchange-traded products on their platforms. Danske Bank said on 11 February 2026 that customers on its trading platform can invest in selected ETPs that track bitcoin and ethereum.
